activation: ego body overtakes and clears lead body on the lead's right

metrics.passing_right_geometry_frames: Count ego rear beyond lead front while ego body lies wholly to lead's right
metrics.min_ego_body_to_obstruction_clearance_m: Minimum Euclidean gap from observed ego body rectangle to observed object radius over all source frames
metrics.object_pixel_reviewed: Original camera review must resolve object visibility before a physical or legal claim
metrics.one_way_designation_verified: Independent original source must establish legal one-way designation
metrics.pavement_condition_verified: Original source must establish unobstructed width for the full pass

fallback_triggers.fallback1: Measured object clearance below 0.5 m in a pass attempt calls for slower controlled retry
fallback_triggers.fallback2: Object or lane pixels not reviewed calls for elevated overview retry
fallback_triggers.fallback3: One-way designation or pavement condition unverified calls for stop-before-obstruction retry
